exercises.title: Elicitation planning 1 — the life of an interview
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers splits each elicitation activity into prepare → perform → follow up. Put the steps of one interview with the head of a dormitory in order.

Drag the items into the right order; the explanation appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Wiegers chia mỗi hoạt động khai thác thành chuẩn bị → thực hiện → theo dõi. Sắp thứ tự các bước của một buổi phỏng vấn trưởng ký túc xá.

Kéo các mục về đúng thứ tự; giải thích hiện sau khi nộp.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Elicitation planning 1 — the life of an interview — answer key

1. Order the stepsSắp các bước
   Answer: a) Define the goal of the interview and read the dormitory rules  →  b) Prepare open questions and a draft process model  →  c) Send the invitation with the goal and the agenda  →  d) Run the interview, stay in scope and take notes  →  e) Summarise the notes and send them to the interviewee within a day  →  f) Classify the input and record open issues
   Prepare (goal, questions, invitation) → perform → follow up (notes, classification, issues).VI: Chuẩn bị → thực hiện → theo dõi.

exercises.title: Elicitation planning 2 — open, closed or leading question?
exercises.problemHtml:
Open questions invite a description; closed questions ask for a fact or a choice; leading questions suggest the answer the asker wants. Classify the questions a BA prepared for the dormitory interview.

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Câu hỏi mở mời mô tả; câu hỏi đóng hỏi một dữ kiện hay một lựa chọn; câu hỏi dẫn dắt gợi sẵn câu trả lời người hỏi muốn. Phân loại câu hỏi BA chuẩn bị cho buổi phỏng vấn KTX.

Mỗi dòng được chấm riêng; giải thích từng đáp án hiện sau khi nộp.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Elicitation planning 2 — open, closed or leading question? — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Open
   - r1.k: Closed
   - r2.k: Leading
   - r3.k: Open
   - r4.k: Closed
   - r5.k: Leading
   - r6.k: Open
   Use open questions to explore, closed ones to confirm facts, and avoid leading questions — they put the BA’s solution into the customer’s mouth.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Use open questions to explore, closed ones to confirm facts, and avoid leading questions — they put the BA’s solution into the customer’s mouth.

bang.de:
Choose the right value for every row.

Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.

o.s: How do students report a broken air conditioner today?
How many rooms does building B have?
You would prefer an app to the paper form, right?
What happens when two students report the same problem?
Do repairs happen on weekends — yes or no?
Surely the slow repairs are the technicians’ fault?
Can you walk me through the last repair that went wrong?

bang.giaiThich: Use open questions to explore, closed ones to confirm facts, and avoid leading questions — they put the BA’s solution into the customer’s mouth.

mistakesJson.loi: Coi câu hỏi số lượng là câu mở.
Không nhận ra câu dẫn dắt có đuôi "right?".

# Elicitation planning 3 — pitfalls and their remedies — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Keep a parking lot of off-topic items and return to the agenda
   - r1.k: Ask "why?" until you reach the underlying need
   - r2.k: Invite representatives of every user class and the decision makers
   - r3.k: Ask about exceptions: "what if… fails?"
   - r4.k: Write down assumptions and confirm them with the stakeholders
   - r5.k: Give the participants the goal and materials in advance
   Stay in scope, dig for needs behind solutions, get the right people, explore exceptions, surface assumptions, prepare participants.

o.s: The workshop drifts into a debate about the colour of the app.
A manager says "we need a chatbot" without saying why.
Only managers attended; no student or technician was there.
Everyone describes the happy path; nobody mentions what happens when a part is out of stock.
The BA "knows" how dormitories work and does not check.
Participants arrive without having read anything and spend an hour catching up.

# Elicitation planning 4 — the elicitation plan — answer key

1. Which item does NOT belong in an elicitation plan?Mục nào KHÔNG thuộc kế hoạch khai thác?
   Answer: c) The database schema
   The database design is not part of planning elicitation.VI: Thiết kế CSDL không thuộc kế hoạch khai thác.

2. Why plan the ORDER of techniques?Vì sao phải lập THỨ TỰ kỹ thuật?
   Answer: b) Early techniques (document analysis, interviews) prepare later ones (workshops, prototypes)
   You arrive at a workshop with a straw-man model from the earlier work.VI: Bạn tới workshop với mô hình nháp từ các bước trước.

3. A risk of the dormitory elicitation is that students are on holiday in August. Where do you write it?Một rủi ro của việc khai thác KTX là sinh viên nghỉ hè tháng 8. Ghi ở đâu?
   Answer: b) In the risks of the elicitation plan, with a mitigation such as an online questionnaire
   Planned risks come with mitigations.VI: Rủi ro được lập kế hoạch kèm cách giảm thiểu.
